notes: UX-01 Batch 3 hotfix - local click-through test found clicking 'Hồ sơ đánh giá' from a learner-looking screen produced /ql/checklist/ho-so-danh-gia and rendered nothing new. Root cause: the button lived in roleWorkspaceContentHtml's shared personal-Checklist fallback, which is reached by BOTH a true learner (routeRole='learner', no grant) AND a manager-role account with no Checklist permission grant (routeRole='manager', hasManagementAccess=false at /ql/checklist - pre-existing app behaviour, not introduced by Batch 3). The button computed its target via routeRole(currentRouteKey()), which correctly mirrors whichever URL the account was already on - so a /ql/checklist session (confirmed possible only because requireRoles(['manager']) in phf-url-router.js already gates /ql/* on session role==='manager', sourced 1:1 from phf-server-auth.js sessionUser.role) was correctly sent to /ql/checklist/ho-so-danh-gia, where managerSectionContentHtml requires hasManagementAccess and therefore never renders assessmentProfileHtml() - URL changed, screen did not. Fix: replaced the single action button with a 2-tab nav (Checklist của tôi / Hồ sơ đánh giá, reusing the existing .phfck-people-scope-tabs/.phfck-people-scope-chips pill style) gated strictly on the explicit isLearnerRoute=routeRole(path)==='learner' condition - not on absence of a grant - so the manager-role-no-grant fallback reverts to exactly its pre-Batch-3 rendering (no tabs, no dead-end button); business decision on whether that account class should ever see an assessment profile was intentionally left untouched, per instruction, rather than guessed at. Tabs navigate via literal hardcoded paths through window.phfNavigate() (the real router), not a recomputed routeRole(). Also removed the now-redundant 'back to Checklist của tôi' button (superseded by the tab bar). No backend/permission/API/score/history/Admin/violation code touched. Regression: scripts/test-checklist-assessment-profile-ui.js extended with checks for the explicit isLearnerRoute gate, hardcoded tab targets, and removal of the old ambiguous entry points - 55 checks total. Full checklist suite (15 scripts, including 33/33 Batch1/2 backend) re-run clean.
